nodes.description: Owned.owner: owner address written from msg.sender in the Owned constructor and updated in acceptOwnership
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership
EPay.symbol public token symbol set to EPAY in the constructor
EPay.name public token name set to EPay in the constructor
EPay.decimals public token decimals set to 18 in the constructor
EPay._totalSupply total token supply, minted to a fixed address in the constructor
EPay.balances mapping(address=>uint) holding per-account token balances
EPay.allowed mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding ERC20 allowances
SafeMath.safeAdd: returns a+b after an overflow require; used by transfer and transferFrom
SafeMath.safeSub: returns a-b after requiring b<=a; used by transfer and transferFrom
SafeMath.safeMul: returns a*b with an overflow check
SafeMath.safeDiv: returns a/b requiring b>0
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender
Owned.onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; guards transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token
Owned.transferOwnership: stores a pending new owner, callable only by the current owner
Owned.acceptOwnership: requires msg.sender == newOwner then transfers ownership and clears newOwner
EPay constructor that sets token metadata, mints the whole supply and emits Transfer
EPay.totalSupply: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction
EPay.balanceOf: returns balances[tokenOwner]
EPay.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd
EPay.approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval
EPay.transferFrom: moves tokens from a source address and decrements the caller allowance
EPay.allowance: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
EPay.approveAndCall: approves a spender then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract
EPay fallback function, payable, immediately reverts to reject ETH
EPay.transferAnyERC20Token: onlyOwner rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract

External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract
